levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة بن مسعود

notes: Four named transmitters at one level are alternatives (rule 2): ابن شهاب says «أخبرني» each of them
The text then says «الذي حدثني عروة عن عائشة» : the Aisha route is explicitly via عروة; the other three are said to have told parts. The rules do not settle whether they are separate routes to عائشة
The report is very long; the matn is not read beyond the chain
